body:
weight: light
tier: 0
charter: C2

Build `factory/bin/claim.sh`, `factory/bin/heartbeat.sh` and `factory/bin/release.sh` per SPEC-v0.2 'Claim protocol' (docs/spec/SPEC-v0.2.txt). The lock is a git ref, not the Issue assignee. Creating a ref through the GitHub API fails with 422 if the ref exists; that is the only compare-and-swap. Shared helpers go in factory/bin/lib/.

Acceptance criteria (each verified by `make test`, offline, with a fake `gh` on PATH under tests/fakes/ that emulates `POST /repos/{r}/git/refs` 422-on-exists, `PATCH ...refs/locks/issue-N` with force, `DELETE`, and `gh issue edit/comment`):
1. `claim.sh --json` lists Issues labeled `ready` and `w:<weight>` with weight <= the node's capacity, oldest first, skipping any whose lock ref exists; verified by tests/test_claim.sh case 'skips-locked'.
2. On the first unlocked Issue it POSTs `refs/locks/issue-<n>` with sha = a commit on the `nodes` branch carrying `{handle, run_id, slots, claimed_at}`; on 422 or any error it moves to the next Issue with no retry on the same one; verified by case 'cas-422-moves-on'.
3. On success it runs `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me --add-label in-progress` and writes exactly one comment (handle, fleet run id, slot count, expected finish); verified by case 'one-comment'.
4. `heartbeat.sh <n>` force-updates the lock ref to a new commit with a fresh `claimed_at`; a lock whose commit is older than 24 h is reported stale by `claim.sh --check <n>`; verified by case 'heartbeat-and-stale'.
5. `release.sh <n>` deletes only a ref this node holds (handle in the lock commit matches); another node's ref is refused with exit 2; verified by case 'never-delete-foreign-lock'.
6. Every script: `set -euo pipefail`, `--dry-run` for writers, `--json` for readers, shellcheck -S warning clean; verified by `make lint`.

Out of scope: the janitor's stale-lock sweep (T3), the run loop (build order 2).
title: Implement the git-ref claim protocol: claim, heartbeat, release
